claim.supported_scope: Simultaneous ordinary-ML two-group CFA hierarchy for continuous reflective models: configural, metric loading equality, and scalar intercept equality with an identified mean structure; named partial releases are manual and fully recorded.
claim.estimand: Adjacent restricted-minus-less-restricted chi-square and degrees-of-freedom differences, with delta CFI and delta RMSEA diagnostics for the frozen configural, metric, and scalar hierarchy.
assumptions: Exactly two independent observed groups share the same indicator-factor pattern, observed variables, row policy, ML estimator, and identification convention.
Every hierarchy step is a valid nested constrained refit and converges to a finite admissible solution.
Scalar testing uses an explicitly identified mean structure with corresponding observed intercepts and latent means.
exclusions: More than two groups, dependent/longitudinal groups, ordinal thresholds, robust/WLSMV estimation, strict residual invariance, alignment, and approximate/Bayesian invariance are excluded.
Automatic modification-index constraint release is excluded; partial releases must be explicitly named by the user.
The synthetic cbsem_invariance_v1 preview cannot be promoted or relabeled as v2.
warnings: A failed earlier hierarchy step blocks all later steps.
Delta-CFI and delta-RMSEA heuristics are diagnostics, not universal truth or substitutes for model identification and substantive judgment.

equations.expression: Delta_chi2_s = chi2_restricted_s - chi2_previous_s; Delta_df_s = df_restricted_s - df_previous_s
x_g = nu_g + Lambda_g eta_g + epsilon_g; scalar imposes nu_1 = nu_2 and Lambda_1 = Lambda_2

references.citation: Meredith (1993), Measurement Invariance, Factor Analysis and Factorial Invariance, DOI 10.1007/BF02294825
Joreskog (1971), Simultaneous Factor Analysis in Several Populations, DOI 10.1007/BF02291466
Independent Python simultaneous constrained-ML configural/metric/scalar reference

simulations.design: Two-group CFA models with exact configural, metric, scalar, loading-noninvariant, and intercept-noninvariant conditions across group balance, size, loading, and intercept magnitude.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen group-specific scenario and replicate seeds with deterministic optimizer settings.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Null rejection intervals must contain nominal alpha, power and numerical agreement must meet preregistered limits, and later steps must never run after an earlier failure.

simulations.design: Named valid and invalid loading/intercept releases, automatic-search attempts, and mean-structure omissions.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Only explicit valid named releases may run, every release must persist, and scalar testing without an identified mean structure must be blocked.

boundaries.case: A group or hierarchy step is singular, unidentified, nonconverged, non-finite, or has an inadmissible variance.
boundaries.expected_behavior: That step fails explicitly and every later step is blocked.

boundaries.case: The design has other than two groups, different indicator patterns, ordinal data, no scalar mean structure, or automatic constraint search.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Setup or the affected step is blocked before an inferential result is emitted.

boundaries.case: The two group labels are swapped while observations and equality constraints are unchanged.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Fit statistics, difference tests, and invariance decisions remain equal within tolerance after remapping group-specific estimates.

boundaries.case: The same data, groups, hierarchy, releases, and optimizer settings execute repeatedly.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Constraints, fits, diagnostics, failures, and summaries are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: A group, constraint, release, fit, delta, hierarchy status, mean-structure flag, or method identity is changed.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose identity differs from CB-SEM measurement invariance v2.
Reject output relabeled from cbsem_invariance_v1 or another method.
Reject either group or hierarchy step when the dataset fingerprint differs.
Reject an archive entry whose group model, constraints, releases, or result checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid hierarchy, inconsistent constraints, non-finite deltas, or scalar results without mean structure.
Never reinterpret arithmetically synthesized cbsem_invariance_v1 diagnostics as constrained-refit v2 evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: The cbsem_invariance_v1 preview remains experimental and is permanently ineligible for v2 evidence or migration.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must produce identical group rows, constraints, refits, hierarchy blocking, fit deltas, and diagnostics for the same recipe.
accessibility_rules: Hierarchy and fit visuals have equivalent accessible tables.
Passed, failed, blocked, partially released, and warning states are conveyed without color alone.
